bottleneck.description: Big-4 industrial robot manufacturer with strong servo motor/motion control franchise; peer-competitive with Fanuc, ABB, KUKA.

dependency.key_customers: Automotive OEMs (welding, painting), electronics assembly, semiconductor handling, general industrial
dependency.key_suppliers: Renesas, Rohm and other Japanese semiconductor and component suppliers

editorial.notes: Yaskawa is a Big-4 robot OEM (~8-12% share) and a leader in servo motors and AC drives, but the Big-4 oligopoly is contested both internally and increasingly by Chinese entrants (Estun, Inovance, Siasun) plus collaborative-robot challengers. Calibration anchor 6954 JP Fanuc is LOW; Yaskawa sits in the same peer set. Servo motors are also a competitive subsystem with Mitsubishi, Siemens, Rockwell and Chinese alternatives.
